race.comment: DAISYDOO (9) was well found fresh but was left with too much ground to bridge. Better for that hit-out, and she will relish the anticipated tempo. Expecting her to be blending in beautifully at the top of the straight. NEXTONIXS (2) returns and ticks a lot of boxes. She's a noted fresh performer and is a track and trip specialist. Has trialled up strongly and gets an important 2kg claim to aid the big weight. Bold showing anticipated.  ZANTHRON (4) strips fitter second-up after holding on gamely into third here two weeks ago. Is drawn to advantage on the inside and meets the winner with a 2kg swing. Will be in this for a long way. DEMOJO (1) is proving tough to catch this prep but could be unlocked with the blinkers on first time. Draws well and is a genuine top three hope. REAL DELUXE (3) kept them all at bay here two weeks ago to bring up her third win of the prep. Concedes weight to a lot of them but is going too well to ignore.
